description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling The Immortal Weapons.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning The Immortal Weapons from exile to the battlefield.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
